overall.note: One playthrough, no mission replay: keep manual saves before big missions and keep cheats off until the platinum pops. The story runs about 60 hours; the open-world grinds (stunts, shooting ranges, challenges, collectibles) are the other 140.

stages.guidance: Play the main missions in order from the opening mission Gone Fishing through the final mission. The 12 story trophies unlock as the story reaches them: 2 chapter trophies in Chapter 1, 3 more across Chapters 2 to 4, the gold finale trophy, and 6 mission trophies (Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory). There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save before every big mission. Two things to do during the story, not after it: meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot before the chapter ends (the one confirmed missable trophy, Positive Mental Attitude) and keep cheats off — they disable trophies.
stages.name: The story, start to finish

stages.guidance: Sweep Leonida region by region rather than criss-crossing the map: 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, 100 WAiNK It spots, 100 vehicles to drive, all 52 regions to visit, 3 full collectible card decks, 10 Scooter Bros deliveries, and 8 purchasable garages. Start the meditation sweep in Chapter 1 (see stage 1) and pick up spots as the story opens new regions. Note the one count clash in the sources: the trophy text says 8 garages, while PowerPyx's property database lists 12 — buy 8 and the trophy should pop; the extra 4 are spares, not requirements.
stages.name: Exploration & collectibles

stages.guidance: The combat set is short and mostly free-roam: 5 kills with Combat Focus, an escape from the VCIA airport, a Rhino tank takedown, a clean jewelry-store robbery, 5 bank vaults cracked, one armored-truck blitz, and 9 gang operations cleared. Do the bank vaults and gang operations as they appear on the map between other stages — none of them is gated — and save the tank and airport escapes for a quiet moment with full health and a fast getaway car.
stages.name: Combat & crime

stages.guidance: The hardest and longest stage — the platinum's real grind. Three big counts dominate it: 250 stunts out of 397 across Leonida, 42 shooting-range golds across 12 ranges, and 50 challenges out of 80. Around those: 14 Top Fun drone races, 20 race wins, 9 different activities for Master of None, the fishing challenge against Cal, the arcade high score, a bowling night, a personal best with your partner, and 500 tracked choices. Chip at stunts and challenges during every other stage instead of leaving all 250 stunts to the end; the shooting-range golds are the only genuinely skill-gated ask, so practice the ranges early and come back for gold once your aim is warm.
stages.name: Minigames, races & challenges

stages.guidance: Finish the five side-character strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — plus all 8 stranger missions and the hunt for Bret. These are chapter-gated, not missable, but finish each strand before advancing the story past its window. The misc half is money and partner time: 3 shopping trips with your partner, $100,000 spent in shops, and $250,000 in marked bills moved. Money comes naturally from the story and the stage-3 robberies; if you are short at the end, the repeatable robberies top it up.
stages.name: Side strands & misc

stages.guidance: The 100% completion checklist (A Long Road, gold) opens after the story — work through whatever it still lists, then check the tracker for anything left. The five mystery trophies live here because no source confirms their triggers: PowerPyx asserts methods for In The Beginning…, Capital Offense and The Truth Is Out There, which four other guides leave unconfirmed, while Bad Luck, I Guess and Ten Pin are unknown everywhere. Try the asserted methods, but do not grind blind — these five are the likeliest to get confirmed methods from the community after launch, so check the cited sources again before sinking hours into them.
stages.name: Cleanup & 100%

stages.guidance: Vice Got a Price! pops automatically with the 54th trophy — there is nothing extra to do. If it does not pop, one trophy is still unearned: check the tracker, the 100% checklist, and the five mystery trophies in stage 6 first.
stages.name: Platinum
